operator.history: A=partial_q on H1(R) subset L2(R), skew-adjoint with spectrum iR
operator.incidence: B=B_Sigma is Hilbert-Schmidt and therefore compact

off_history_spectrum.result: P(z) is Fredholm/invertible iff M_U(z) is, whenever D_U and the domains satisfy the stated closed-family hypotheses
off_history_spectrum.index: if D_U(z) is Fredholm then ind P(z)=ind D_U(z); in particular index zero for invertible D_U

on_history_spectrum.assume: D_U(z) boundedly invertible (or split off its finite Fredholm defect)
on_history_spectrum.elimination: P(z) is Fredholm iff A-z-B D_U(z)^-1 B^dagger is Fredholm
on_history_spectrum.essential_spectrum: compact perturbation preserves the essential spectrum of A-z
on_history_spectrum.result: since 0 lies in essential spectrum(A-z), P(z) is not Fredholm

determinant_consequence.valid_region: the history resolvent components Re(z)>0 and Re(z)<0
determinant_consequence.invalid_without_new_rigging: a Fredholm determinant continued through z in iR
possible_repairs: use exponential weights that move the essential history spectrum while proving weight-independent determinant continuation
use limiting-absorption/scattering determinants rather than an ordinary Fredholm determinant
use a boundary Evans determinant built from stable/unstable subspaces instead of the full bilateral operator

coordinate_gate.problem: the prime-delay record uses s=1/2-i z and Im(z)>0, while the paired-history resolvent record uses Re(z)!=0; the same letter z is not yet proven to denote the same centered coordinate
coordinate_gate.required: freeze one map s->z_hist(s) and determine whether the critical line maps into iR or into the history resolvent
coordinate_gate.importance: if Xi zeros map to iR, ordinary Fredholm determinant-class control is impossible in the current unweighted L2 history carrier; if they map off iR, the Schur route remains available there

conclusion: The transverse reduction has fixed index zero automatically only off the bilateral history spectrum. Compact arithmetic incidence cannot repair Fredholmness on that spectrum. The immediate gate is an exact spectral-coordinate convention, followed by either ordinary Schur determinants off-spectrum or a scattering/weighted construction on-spectrum.
